figures.name: 01 Liberal democracy index, Brazil, Poland, Thailand and Zambia, 2003-2024
figures.image_subtitle: Liberal democracy index by V-Dem, using expert estimates. It ranges from 0 (highly autocratic) to 1 (highly democratic).
figures.identification: The image shows four small-multiple line charts (Brazil, Poland, Thailand, Zambia) of V-Dem's liberal democracy index; the x-axis is labelled 2004, 2010, 2015, 2024 and the lines start one year before 2004; the page links the chart liberal-democracy-index. The image was made with V-Dem (2025); the ground truth is the chart's current data (decision 0003).
